## Problem

`overlap_drain = "off"` (rebar.toml:209, landed 08-28 via 2dbdcc8abe2c) disables the enrichment drain, but the PRODUCER side still runs: every plan-review certification unconditionally appends an `ENQUEUE_ENRICH` event to the tickets store (`src/rebar/llm/plan_review/attest.py:216-225` — best-effort `_enqueue_queue.enqueue(...)` with no config check), and `suggest_duplicate_tickets = true` (rebar.toml:40) keeps the advisory overlap feature nominally on.

Evidence: 95 `ENQUEUE_ENRICH` commits appended to the tickets branch in the last 2 days with the drainer off — durable store writes into a queue nothing consumes. Each is a git commit + push on the shared store (the project's top fragility surface; see `.scratch/stability-analysis/E1-store-prototype.md` §enrich and `06-plan.md` A.0.2).

## Fix shape

Guard the certification-time enqueue on the same effective config that governs the drain, so producer and consumer cannot disagree; and set `suggest_duplicate_tickets = false` for this project. Historical queue events stay untouched (read-only history; no backlog drain, no deletion). Read the config through the standard config path (must pass `scripts/check_config_reads.py`).

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] With `overlap_drain = "off"`, a plan-review certification appends NO `ENQUEUE_ENRICH` event (regression test proves it: certify against a throwaway store with drain off, assert no queue event file/commit is produced).
- [x] With the drain enabled, enqueue behavior is unchanged (existing tests still pass).
- [x] `rebar.toml` for this project sets `suggest_duplicate_tickets = false`, with the adjacent comment block (rebar.toml:38, :207) updated so the two settings no longer claim the advisory overlap stays on.
- [x] No existing `ENQUEUE_ENRICH`/`CLAIM_ENRICH`/`DONE_ENRICH` events are modified or deleted.
- [x] No new config key, env var, lock, or guard mechanism is introduced (use the existing `overlap_drain` / `suggest_duplicate_tickets` reads).

## File impact

- src/rebar/llm/plan_review/attest.py — guard the certification-time enqueue on the effective overlap config
- rebar.toml — suggest_duplicate_tickets = false + comment correction
- tests: one regression test for "certification with drain off appends no queue event" (extend the existing queue/attest test module rather than adding a new file)

## Resolution (change 2464, merged 05be3a4dc6e4)

sign_plan_review now gates the enqueue on `verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets` AND `overlap_drain != "off"` — the exact pair `enrich_drain.maybe_drain` reads. Regression test `tests/unit/test_enrich_queue.py::test_cert_with_drain_off_appends_no_queue_event` (RED before the fix) asserts no `*-ENQUEUE_ENRICH.json` is written; `test_cert_enqueues` now enables the feature explicitly and proves drain-on behavior unchanged. rebar.toml sets `suggest_duplicate_tickets = false` with both comment blocks corrected. History untouched; no new config surface.
